title: Component conjugation transport for d-comparison
statement: Existence of an equivalence between system arrows and families compatible with d, with pullback action on R.map.

proof.text: Send a system arrow a to the family r_n(G).inv followed by a.app n followed by r_n(F).hom. Precompose the desired d-compatibility equation with the pullback of r_(n+1)(G).hom, substitute hr for G and F, cancel inverse pairs, and use a.compatibility n.

Send a d-compatible family v to the components r_n(G).hom followed by v_n followed by r_n(F).inv. Postcompose the system compatibility equation with r_n(F).hom. Substitute hr for both objects and cancel the pullback of r_(n+1)(F).inv against its hom; compatibility of v gives the equation.

The two maps are inverse componentwise by the hom-inv identities; equality of compatibility proofs follows by proof irrelevance. These maps define the required equivalence. For R.map w, naturality of r_n gives the stated pullback component after canceling r_n(G).inv with its hom.

lean.statement:
theorem thickeningSystem_hom_transport_d
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {T : ℕ → Scheme.{u}} {i : ∀ n, T n ⟶ T (n + 1)}
    (j : ∀ n, T n ⟶ X) (d : ∀ n, Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (j (n + 1)) ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n) ≅ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (j n))
    (R : CoherentModules X ⥤ CoherentThickeningSystem T i)
    (r : ∀ n, R ⋙ CoherentThickeningSystem.evaluation T i n ≅
      ObjectProperty.ι (RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace) ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (j n))
    (hr : ∀ (F : CoherentModules X) (n : ℕ),
      ((R.obj F).comparison n).hom ≫ (r n).hom.app F =
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map ((r (n + 1)).hom.app F) ≫
          (d n).hom.app F.obj)
    (F G : CoherentModules X) :
    ∃ e : (R.obj G ⟶ R.obj F) ≃
      {v : ∀ n, (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (j n)).obj G.obj ⟶
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (j n)).obj F.obj |
        ∀ n, (d n).hom.app G.obj ≫ v n =
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (i n)).map (v (n + 1)) ≫ (d n).hom.app F.obj},
      ∀ w : G ⟶ F, e (R.map w) =
        ⟨fun n ↦ (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (j n)).map w.hom,
          fun n ↦ ((d n).hom.naturality w.hom).symm⟩
